title: command_state: the side's command state as it will stand when the coming day begins
description: Intents with their limits and the staff's projection, the leaves, the bases' reserves, plans, commitments, the interrupts set, the commands queued for the coming day and the staff's decisions of yesterday with their numbers for why. The staff does nothing for a side until an intent is set (a supply intent needs a forces limit; a hold or cover intent may use the groups at its base).

inside_day.description: Given only at 0600 or 1200, in a game that stops between pulses (decision 0156): the answer was worked on the state as it stands, as if the open day were closed now, before the rest of the day, its fight ashore and its end are resolved; a command is checked again when it is taken in at the next dusk.

base.description: The side's own base the intent names; null for neutralise, deny, stand_at and operate_carriers.

target.description: The enemy base a neutralise, a raid or a bombard is aimed at (decisions 0120 and 0146); null for the other kinds.

hex.description: The centre of the waters of a deny intent as [q, r] (decision 0123), the station of a stand_at or operate_carriers intent, the landing hex of a ready_landing intent, or the place a take_place intent is to take (decision 0142); null for the other kinds.

distance.description: The distance in hexes of the waters of a deny intent (decision 0123); null for the other kinds.

task_force.description: The side's number of the task force a stand_at, operate_carriers, ready_landing or bombard intent names (decisions 0124, 0125, 0141 and 0146); null for the other kinds (a take_place has none). hex is then its station.

by_day.description: The morning of the day a ready_landing or take_place intent is to be ready by or to have taken the place by (decisions 0141 and 0142); null for the other kinds and for one with no date.

wants.description: What a build_up intent wants, in order (decision 0141); null for the other kinds.

island.description: The number of the island a control_island intent names (decision 0151); null for the other kinds.

defences.description: The points of defences a build_up intent wants, from 1 to 100, when defences is among its wants (decision 0141); null otherwise.

phase.description: Where a take_place intent stands (decision 0142): prepare while its plan is preparing, move while it is released and no man of the side is ashore at the place, land once one is; null for every other kind and for a plan in any other state.

interval.description: For keep_supplied: the days between shipments, or "not set: the staff uses 15"; null for the other kinds.

served.description: Its place in the order the staff serves the intents in force, 1 first; null where withdrawn.

displaced_by.description: The commitments to other plans that keep the intent from a run today or cut its load, from the proposal's shortfall; empty where none.

parent.description: The intent it stands under; null for a root.

addressee.description: The level it is given to: "the area", a base, or a task force (decisions 0124 and 0125).

children.description: The intents in force directly under it.

depth.description: How many intents are above it; 0 for a root.

measure.description: A hold intent (its hold measure), a neutralise intent (its neutralise measure), a deny intent (its deny measure) or a control_island intent (its island measure) only.

intents.description: Every intent of the side, each root by number with the intents under it listed after it (a sub-intent under its parent); a withdrawn one stays in the list.

picture.description: With command levels on: the area command's picture of the enemy, its contacts with the area command's own numbers (decision 0138, 3). Left out with command levels off.

reports_travel.description: Whether reports travel between your commands in this game, so that pictures can differ.

own.description: Whether the report that last made or refreshed the contact here was the area command's own search, strike or fight, not one it was told of.

forces_held.description: With command levels on: each task force and base the area command holds, as it holds it, with the moment that is of (decision 0138, 3). Empty where nothing is held (no report figures). Left out with command levels off.

as_of.description: The moment the held state is of, as list_forces says it: "the start", "the morning of day 2". Always given here.

current.description: True when it is of the pulse just ended.

radio_silence.description: A task force only: whether it is on radio silence.

available_from.description: The day from which the side may use the unit (decision 0140, 5), given only while that day has not come. Left out otherwise.

holds.description: What you hold from the staff: each hold with its target in your numbers, the day it was made, what made it (a hold command of yours, or an order of yours to a unit in an intent's forces limit) and that order's number, and the words.

order.description: For a hold made by an order: the order's number as the side is shown it; null for a hold command.
